{{Top|fca|legends=Unidentified courier droid}} {{Update|[[Bounty Hunters 42]], [[Duel of the Reprobates]], [[Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace 1]]}} {{Droid |type=Hutt Cartel |image=[[File:TorturedDroid-ROTJ.png]] |name=80-M |homeworld= |birth= |death=Sometime before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]]''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' |creator= |manufacturer= |line= |model= |class=[[Protocol droid]] |cost= |length= |width= |height= |mass= |gender= |pronouns=He/him{{Film|VI}} |sensor= |plating= |armament= |equipment= |affiliation=*[[Hutt Clan]] **[[Jabba's criminal empire]] }} {{Quote|We have been without an interpreter since our master got angry with our last protocol droid and disintegrated him.''"
"''Disintegrated?|EV-9D9 and C-3PO|audio=EV-9D9-Disintegrated.flac|}} '''80-M''',''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' also know as '''Eightyem''', was a [[protocol droid]][[Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace 1|''Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace'' 1]] who served as the [[Translator droid|interpreter]] of [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure]], a [[Hutt]] [[crime lord]] who led his own [[Jabba's criminal empire|criminal empire]], until he angered his master and was disintegrated. Shortly before the [[Rescue of Han Solo]] in [[4 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' [[EV-9D9]], the [[supervisor]] of [[Boba Fett's Palace|Jabba's Palace's]] droid pool, supervised the [[torture]] of the old [[droid]] when [[R2-D2]] and [[C-3PO]], Jabba's new [[Translator|interpreter]], reported to her. EV-9D9 told C-3PO of his predecessor's fate and gestured towards the droid. C-3PO was horrified to witness the droid on a vertical torture rack that stretched its manacled [[limb]]s further than they could extend,[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars Episode VI: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] causing the droid to scream in pain as its arms and legs were slowly pulled off. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|Eve-Ninedenine, I believe master Jabba requires a new protocol droid. Our approach was a bit extreme on the last one.''"
"''I thought we were restrained. He was frightfully annoying.''"
"''His Excellency Jabba the Hutt is prone to exaggeration, so perhaps we shouldn't be so literal next time.|[[8D8]] and EV-9D9, in "The Key to Remembering"|{{StoryCite|story=The Key to Remembering|book=From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi}}}} 80-M first appeared, albeit unidentified, in the [[1983]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], the final installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[original trilogy]]. The character was later identified in a preview article on [[StarWars.com]] for the comic [[Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace 1|''Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace'' 1]], that was published on [[March 22]], [[2023]].{{SW|url=news/marvel-jabbas-palace-1|text=Learn the Untold Story of Jabba's Last Protocol Droid in Marvel's ''Star Wars: Jabba's Palace'' #1 - Exclusive Preview}} The [[2024]] reference book ''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'', later provided the droid's designation. [[File:New_Aquisitions_ROTJ.png|thumb|200px|right|A CZ-series droid dumped near the doorway of the torture chamber.]] The [[2015]] young-readers novelization ''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' written by [[Tom Angleberger]], originally identified the droid as a separate character to the droid shown in the film and that his remains had been dumped near the door of a furnace in her [[torture]] chamber. A [[CZ-series secretary/business communications droid|CZ-series droid]], having been dumped besides the doorway, appears during the events of ''Return of the Jedi''. "[[The Key to Remembering]]," a short story written by [[Olivia Chadha]] as part of the 2023 anthology ''[[From a Certain Point of View: Return of the Jedi]]'', indicates Jabba's previous interpreter was melted down in a pool of [[acid]] and separately identifies the droid present on the torture rack as a [[courier droid]]. ==Appearances== *''[[Star Wars: The Original Trilogy – A Graphic Novel]]'' *{{StoryCite|story=Duel of the Reprobates|book=Revelations (2023) 1}} *[[Bounty Hunters 42|''Bounty Hunters'' 42]] *{{Film|VI}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi (paperback novel)|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' junior novelization]] *''[[Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side!]]'' {{Ab|Return of the Jedi: Beware the Power of the Dark Side! (audiobook)}} *[[Star Wars: Return of the Jedi Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: Return of the Jedi'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] {{Mo}} *[[Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace 1|''Return of the Jedi – Jabba's Palace'' 1]] ==Sources== *{{SW|url=news/the-illustrious-jabba-the-hutt-bids-you-welcome-to-his-new-marvel-comic-jabbas-palace-exclusive-reveal|text=The Illustrious Jabba the Hutt Bids You Welcome to His New Marvel Comic, ''Jabba's Palace'' - Exclusive Reveal}} {{Po}} *{{InsiderCite|217|Launchpad}} {{Po}} *{{SW|url=news/marvel-jabbas-palace-1|text=Learn the Untold Story of Jabba's Last Protocol Droid in Marvel's ''Star Wars: Jabba's Palace'' #1 - Exclusive Preview}} {{1stID|Eightyem}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia: The Comprehensive Guide to the Star Wars Galaxy]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=80-M |nl=80-M }} [[Category:Desilijic servants]] [[Category:Droids of the Hutt Clan]] [[Category:Droids with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Droids with unspecified gender programming]] [[Category:Protocol droids]]
